> **This is a brainstorm, not a commitment to build.** Outcomes can include
> "proceed to research", "defer", "discard", or "merge into another issue."
> Brainstorm issues are explicitly exploratory — no obligation to ship.

## Problem

What's the underlying problem or opportunity? Why is this worth exploring now?

## Proposed Direction

A rough sketch of how this might work. Not a spec — just the shape of an
approach.

## Fixes vs. Adds

Is this fixing existing pain, adding new capability, or both? Be explicit
about which existing things (if any) would be replaced, deprecated, or
deleted.

## Open Questions

Things the brainstorm doesn't yet have answers for. Concrete questions are
better than vague concerns.

## Suggested Next Experiment

What's the smallest thing that would tell us whether this direction is worth
pursuing? (e.g., spike a prototype, audit an existing system, write a
one-page design doc.)

## Additional Context

Any other information that would help frame the exploration.
